name: LoanAccount
description: The active loan ledger account created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) in PH-021 (JRN-007) at first drawdown. Tracks outstanding balance, repayment schedule, and next payment date throughout the loan term. Distinct from BusinessAccount (ENT-080) — a customer may have multiple concurrent LoanAccount records. Each record requires independent IFRS 9 ECL staging assessment per-instrument.

fields.name: outstanding_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. Non-negative decimal, 2 dp (GBP). Updated on each repayment and drawdown. EAD input for Basel 3.1 RWA and IFRS 9 ECL.

fields.name: next_payment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when status = repaid.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | arrears | default | watch_list | repaid | closed.

fields.name: drawn_down_amount
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, 2 dp (GBP). Cumulative total drawn. <= FacilityAgreement.approved_amount.

fields.name: drawdown_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of first drawdown. Immutable. Interest accrual start date.

fields.name: maturity_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). drawdown_date + term_months. Immutable unless formally extended.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation_rule: System-generated. ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on any field mutation.

relationships.description: LoanAccount belongs to one BusinessCustomer. A BusinessCustomer may have multiple concurrent LoanAccount records.
LoanAccount is governed by one FacilityAgreement via facility_id FK.
LoanAccount has zero or more CovenantMonitoring records.

design_decisions.decision: LoanAccount is a separate entity from BusinessAccount (ENT-080).
design_decisions.rationale: A term loan carries distinct amortisation logic, IFRS 9 staging, and covenant monitoring. Conflating with the current account prevents multi-facility structures and violates IFRS 9 per-instrument staging requirements.
